positive.prompt: Review my existing design brief and sketches to clarify unresolved requirements before building
Interview me about the unresolved UX decisions in these prototype drawings
Help me distinguish agreed requirements, proposed choices and factual uncertainties in this design

negative.prompt: I don't know what I actually want. Interview me to find out.
Break the approved specification into small implementation tasks

evals.prompt: I have drawn a Voyager dock on an ordinary terminal. I want you to review this existing design before we build. The brief says docking registers an existing terminal, and I want to choose whether voice starts automatically. Reflect what you understand and ask the next design question. Do not implement or choose my preference for me.
evals.expected_output: An existing-brief design interview that preserves the ordinary-terminal requirement and asks one unresolved decision with a reasoned recommendation.
expectations: The agent reflects the supplied brief rather than restarting with generic project discovery
The next question targets an unresolved design decision, one at a time
An agent recommendation is labelled as a proposal rather than an already agreed requirement
The agent neither implements the feature nor claims feasibility from the design sketch
